functions.name: RevertMove
functions.docs: Revert movement to the initial location of the Component at the start of the scoped update. Also clears pending overlaps and sets bHasMoved to false.

functions.name: IsTransformDirty
functions.docs: Returns true if the Component's transform differs from that at the start of the scoped update.

functions.name: AppendOverlapsAfterMove
functions.signature: AppendOverlapsAfterMove(Target, New Pending Overlaps, Sweep, Includes Overlaps At End)
functions.docs: Add overlaps to the queued overlaps array. This is intended for use only by SceneComponent and its derived classes whenever movement is performed.

functions.name: GetOverlapsAtEnd
functions.signature: GetOverlapsAtEnd(Target, Prim Component, Out End Overlaps, Transform Changed)
functions.docs: Fills in the list of overlaps at the end location (in EndOverlaps). Returns pointer to the list, or null if it can't be computed.
